description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'DelegateTarget' which implements the 'Target' interface. It serves as a delegate or wrapper around another 'Target' instance, extending its functionality for specific protocols by delegating method calls to the underlying target object. The class provides implementations for methods such as getAddress, getOriginalAddress, getTopics, getAuthorizationContext, and getHeaderMapping, and overrides equals, hashCode, and toString methods.
